# Nick Kontonicolaou — NYC Real Estate Agent, Based in Astoria & Ditmars

> Nick Kontonicolaou (legal name Nickolaos Kontonicolaou-Dits) is a licensed New York real estate salesperson with Modern Spaces. He was born and raised in New York City, is based in Astoria and Ditmars in Queens, NY, speaks English, Greek, Ukrainian and Russian, and works with renters, buyers, sellers and landlords across all of New York City: Queens, Brooklyn, Manhattan, the Bronx and Staten Island.

## Languages
- English, Greek (Ελληνικά), Ukrainian (Українська), Russian (Русский)

## Areas served (home base: Astoria & Ditmars)
Rough price ranges as of November 2026.
- Ditmars-Steinway (11105): quieter, leafy, family-friendly north end of Astoria; Astoria Park, waterfront, Greek tavernas; N/W at Astoria–Ditmars Blvd. 1BR about $2,300–$3,200.
- Central Astoria (11102, 11103, 11106): Broadway, 30th Ave, Steinway St; most restaurants and nightlife; N/W and M/R. 1BR about $2,400–$3,200, 2BR about $3,200–$4,500.
- Astoria Heights (11105): one- and two-family homes with driveways near LaGuardia. Rentals about $2,000–$3,200; houses about $1M–$1.6M.
- Long Island City (11101): amenity towers with skyline views, one stop from Midtown. 1BR about $3,500–$4,500; condos about $800K–$2M+.
- Sunnyside (11104): prewar co-ops and Sunnyside Gardens, 15 minutes to Grand Central on the 7. 1BR about $2,200–$2,800; co-ops about $250K–$550K.
- Brooklyn: 1BR about $2,500–$4,500+.
- Manhattan: 1BR about $3,000–$5,500+.
- The Bronx, Staten Island and the rest of New York.
